Theme

Travel & transport

hand luggage noun

* our formation

* (our own formation) sarcina manuālis

Traupman 216 prints sarcinulae manuālēs.

Other words

  • sarcinulae manuālēs — hand luggage

    also used · modern · Traupman 213, 216; Traupman 325

Examples

  • sarcinula, sarcinulae f.

    a small piece of luggageTraupman 217

  • Licetne hanc sarcinulam manuālem mēcum in āëroplanum portāre?

    May I take this hand luggage with me on the plane?Traupman 213

See also luggage, e-ticket.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 213–217, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
